meta.review_notes: Camera/microphone access and children's data protections are not addressed in the privacy policy. Strict legal-safe review flagged these as unknown.

app.name: Telegram Messenger
app.description: A free, cloud-based messaging app focused on speed and security, offering group chats, channels, and optional end-to-end encrypted secret chats.

verdict.one_liner: Telegram does not show you ads and does not sell your data, but your regular chats are stored on its servers and only secret chats are truly private.
verdict.summary: Telegram is a privacy-focused messaging app with a strong commitment to no ads and no data selling. It offers genuinely end-to-end encrypted secret chats and calls, but standard cloud chats are stored on Telegram's servers with server-side encryption only. A phone number is required to sign up, and IP addresses may be retained for up to 12 months for anti-abuse purposes. The app provides excellent deletion controls including self-destruct timers and message deletion for all participants.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Telegram is a solid choice for messaging privacy, especially if you use secret chats for sensitive conversations. It does not track you for ads and provides strong user rights and deletion controls.

red.title: Regular chats are not end-to-end encrypted
red.plain_english: Telegram states it stores cloud chat messages on its servers and holds the encryption keys. Only secret chats use true end-to-end encryption where only you and the recipient can read messages.

red.title: A phone number is required to sign up
red.plain_english: Telegram states you must provide a mobile phone number to create an account.

red.title: Your IP address may be kept for up to 12 months
red.plain_english: Telegram states it may collect your IP address and device information to fight spam and abuse, and this metadata can be stored for up to 12 months. It may disclose your IP address and phone number to authorities if ordered by a court.

red.title: Third-party bots receive your messages and profile
red.plain_english: Telegram states that when you interact with bots, the third-party bot developers can receive your public profile data and messages.

green.title: No ads and no tracking for advertising
green.plain_english: Telegram explicitly states it does not use your data to show ads and does not track your behavior to sell to advertisers.

green.title: Secret chats and calls are end-to-end encrypted
green.plain_english: Telegram states secret chats use end-to-end encryption, meaning even Telegram cannot read the content. Voice and video calls are also end-to-end encrypted.

green.title: Strong deletion and self-destruct controls
green.plain_english: Telegram states you can delete your entire account permanently, delete messages for all chat participants, and set messages to self-destruct.

green.title: No data sold to third parties
green.plain_english: Telegram states it does not sell your personal information to advertisers or data brokers.

green.title: Open source project
green.plain_english: Telegram states it is an open source project and publishes its source code.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not explain when or how the app accesses your camera and microphone.
categories.detail: The policy mentions voice and video calls and voice-to-text features, but does not explicitly describe camera or microphone permissions.
concerns: Policy is silent on camera and microphone access

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Telegram only accesses your location when you choose to share it in a chat or use optional features like Live Location or People Nearby.
categories.detail: The policy states location data is treated like other messages when shared in chats. Live Location and People Nearby continue broadcasting while active, even if the app is closed.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you share your Live Location in any chat or turn on 'Make Myself Visible' in People Nearby, Telegram will use your data to display your location to those users with whom you are sharing it, even when the app is closed – for as long as you keep these optional features activated.
concerns: Live location can continue briefly if app is closed while sharing is active

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Telegram asks your permission before syncing contacts, and only stores the contact's name and phone number. You can stop syncing or erase this data in settings.
categories.detail: The policy states contact syncing is optional and only the contact's name and phone number are retained. Users can halt syncing or erase this information via Settings.
categories.policy_excerpt: Telegram uses phone numbers as unique identifiers so that it is easy for you to switch from SMS and other messaging apps and retain your social graph. We ask your permission before syncing your contacts. We store your up-to-date contacts in order to notify you as soon as one of your contacts signs up for Telegram and to properly display names in notifications. We only need the number and name (first and last) for this to work and store no other data about your contacts.
concerns: Non-users' phone numbers uploaded without their consent if sync is enabled

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Telegram stores your messages, photos, and documents on its servers. Files sent in secret chats are encrypted with a unique key before being stored.
categories.detail: The policy states cloud chat data is stored heavily encrypted on servers. Secret chat media is encrypted with a separate key before upload, appearing as random data to the server.
categories.policy_excerpt: We store messages, photos, videos and documents from your cloud chats on our servers so that you can access your data from any of your devices anytime without having to rely on third-party backups. All data is stored heavily encrypted. When you send photos, videos or files via secret chats, before being uploaded, each item is encrypted with a separate key, not known to the server.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Telegram does not sell or share your data with advertisers. However, third-party bots you interact with receive your public profile and messages. Translation and voice-to-text features may send data to Google or Microsoft.
categories.detail: Telegram's core policy is no data sharing for advertising. Bot interactions transmit data to third-party developers. Translation and voice-to-text may send data to Google/Microsoft under contractual restrictions. Court-ordered disclosure of IP and phone number is possible for suspected criminal activity.
categories.policy_excerpt: Telegram does not process payments from users and instead relies on different payment providers around the world..If Telegram receives a valid order from the relevant judicial authorities that confirms you're a suspect in a case involving criminal activities that violate the Telegram Terms of Service, we will perform a legal analysis of the request and may disclose your IP address and phone number to the relevant authorities..Since Telegram may rely on Google LLC or Microsoft Corporation for automatic translation of messages, the text of any message or set of messages that users choose to translate may be shared with Google or Microsoft
concerns: Bot interactions send data to third-party developers
Voice-to-text and translation may send data to Google/Microsoft
Court-ordered disclosure of IP and phone number possible

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Telegram requires a mobile phone number to sign up. Your chosen screen name, username, and profile picture are public, but real names are not required.
categories.detail: The policy states a verified mobile number is mandatory. Telegram allows pseudonymous use: you choose your username and display name, and real names are not required.
categories.policy_excerpt: Telegram is a communication service. You provide your mobile number and basic account data (which may include profile name, profile picture and about information) to create a Telegram account..We don't want to know your real name, gender, age or what you like.
concerns: Real phone number required — no anonymous use
Username and profile photo visible to other users

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Telegram explicitly states it does not use your data to show ads and does not sell your information to advertisers.
categories.detail: Telegram's privacy policy contains explicit commitments: 'We don't use your data to show you ads' and 'We only store the data that Telegram needs to function.' There is no behavioral tracking for ad targeting.
categories.policy_excerpt: We don't use your data to show you ads..Telegram only stores the information it needs to function as a secure and feature-rich messaging service.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention age requirements or children's data protections.
categories.detail: The privacy policy text does not contain a specific section describing age requirements or children's data protections.
concerns: Policy is silent on children's data

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Telegram may collect metadata such as your IP address and devices used to prevent spam and abuse. This metadata is stored for up to 12 months.
categories.detail: The policy states metadata such as IP addresses, devices used, and username change histories is stored for up to 12 months maximum to combat spam, abuse, and Terms of Service violations.
categories.policy_excerpt: we may collect metadata such as your IP address, devices and Telegram apps you've used, history of username changes, etc. If collected, this metadata can be kept for 12 months maximum.
concerns: IP address retained for up to 12 months
Court-ordered disclosure of IP and phone number possible

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Telegram may collect metadata about your devices and username change history to prevent spam and abuse. It does not clearly explain if it collects advertising identifiers.
categories.detail: The policy mentions collection of 'devices used' and username change histories as metadata for anti-abuse. It does not mention unique advertising identifiers or cross-app device linking.
categories.policy_excerpt: metadata such as your IP address, devices and Telegram apps you've used, history of username changes, etc. If collected, this metadata can be kept for 12 months maximum.
concerns: Device metadata retention up to 12 months
Limited disclosure about exact scope of device data collected

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Telegram does not collect any health or biometric data.
categories.detail: No health or biometric data collection is mentioned or implied in the privacy policy.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Telegram does not collect your payment information. Credit card details go directly to independent payment providers, and Telegram receives only a reusable token.
categories.detail: The policy states payment information never reaches Telegram's servers. Credit card details go directly to independent payment providers, and Telegram receives only a reusable token.
categories.policy_excerpt: Telegram does not process payments from users and instead relies on different payment providers around the world. It is the payment providers that handle and store your credit card details. Neither Telegram nor the merchants on the platform (bot developers) have access to this information..Your credit card information never reaches Telegram's servers. We do not access and do not store your credit card information.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: Telegram states you can delete your entire account permanently, delete messages for all participants in chats, and clear entire chat histories.
categories.detail: The policy states deleting your account removes all cloud-stored data irreversibly. In one-on-one chats, any party can delete messages for both sides without time limits. Accounts self-delete after a configurable inactivity period.
categories.policy_excerpt: Deleting your account removes all messages, media, contacts and every other piece of data you store in the Telegram cloud..As of version 5.5, any party can choose to delete any messages in one-on-one chats, both sent and received, for both sides. There is no time limit.

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Telegram states important policy changes will be notified to you via Telegram. Changes become effective when posted.
categories.detail: The policy states important changes will be notified via Telegram, but does not define what counts as 'important' or explain what happens if you disagree.
categories.policy_excerpt: Important changes made to this Privacy Policy will be notified to you via Telegram..Any changes to this Privacy Policy will become effective when we post the revised Privacy Policy on this page www.telegram.org/privacy.
